def mp_decode(buf, pos=0):

    if b == 0xc0: return None, pos
    if b == 0xc2: return False, pos
    if b == 0xc3: return True, pos
    if b == 0xcc: return buf[pos], pos+1
    if b == 0xcd: return int.from_bytes(buf[pos:pos+2],'big'), pos+2

    if b == 0xcf: return int.from_bytes(buf[pos:pos+8],'big'), pos+8

def decode_wkrp(data):
    if data[:4] != b"WKRP": raise
    version = struct.unpack('<I', data[4:8])[0]
    header_len = struct.unpack('<I', data[8:12])[0]
    if 12+header_len > len(data): raise
    header, _ = mp_decode(data, 12)
    # verify
    assert header["endianness"] == "le"
    P = 16 * ((12 + header_len + 15)//16)
    assert header["payload_origin"] == P
    assert P + header["payload_size"] == len(data)
    sections = header["sections"]
    for s in sections:
        assert s["offset"] % 16 == 0
        assert s["offset"] + s["size"] <= len(data)
        dtype = s["dtype"]; stride = s["stride"]; shape = s["shape"]
        esz = {"u8":1,"i8":1,"u16":2,"i16":2,"u32":4,"i32":4,"u64":8,"i64":8,"f32":4,"f64":8}.get(dtype, stride if dtype=="record" else None)
        if esz is None: raise
        if stride == esz:
            assert s["size"] == stride * prod(shape)
        else:
            assert stride >= esz * shape[-1]
            assert s["size"] == stride * prod(shape[:-1])
    # find sections by name
    poses_sec = next(s for s in sections if s["name"]=="poses")
    contacts_sec = next(s for s in sections if s["name"]=="contacts")
    pose_count = header["pose_count"]
    contact_count = header["contact_count"]
    # parse poses
    poses = []
    off = poses_sec["offset"]
    for i in range(pose_count):
        rec = data[off+i*32: off+(i+1)*32]
        qw,qx,qy,qz = struct.unpack('<4f', rec[0:16])
        cf, cc = struct.unpack('<2I', rec[16:24])
        prob, area = struct.unpack('<2f', rec[24:32])
        poses.append((qw,qx,qy,qz,cf,cc,prob,area))
    # parse contacts
    contacts = []
    off = contacts_sec["offset"]
    for i in range(contact_count):
        x,y,z = struct.unpack('<3f', data[off+i*12: off+(i+1)*12])
        contacts.append((x,y,z))
    # verify invariants
    assert sum(p[5] for p in poses) == contact_count
    if header.get("trials",0) > 0:
        assert abs(sum(p[6] for p in poses) - 1.0) < 1e-3
    # sorted descending
    probs = [p[6] for p in poses]
    assert all(probs[i] >= probs[i+1] for i in range(len(probs)-1))
    # quaternion unit
    for p in poses:
        qw,qx,qy,qz = p[:4]
        assert abs(qw*qw+qx*qx+qy*qy+qz*qz - 1.0) < 1e-6
    return version, header, poses, contacts

def point_decompress(enc):
    y = int.from_bytes(enc, 'little') & ((1<<255)-1)
    sign = enc[31] >> 7
    u = (y*y - 1) % p
    v = (d*y*y + 1) % p
    x = (u * pow(v,3,p) * pow(u * pow(v,7,p), (p-5)//8, p)) % p
    if (v * x*x) % p == (-u) % p:

    if x == 0 and sign == 1:

    if (x & 1) != sign:

    return (x,y)

def point_add(P,Q):
    X1,Y1,Z1,T1 = P
    X2,Y2,Z2,T2 = Q
    A = (Y1-X1)*(Y2-X2) % p
    B = (Y1+X1)*(Y2+X2) % p
    C = T1*2*d*T2 % p
    D = Z1*2*Z2 % p
    E = B-A
    F = D-C
    G = D+C
    H = B+A
    X3 = E*F % p
    Y3 = G*H % p
    T3 = E*H % p
    Z3 = F*G % p
    return (X3,Y3,Z3,T3)

def point_mul(scalar, P):
    # double-and-add
    Q = (0,1,1,0)  # identity
    while scalar:
        if scalar & 1:
            Q = point_add(Q,P)
        P = point_add(P,P)
        scalar >>= 1
    return Q

def point_eq(P,Q):

    X2,Y2,Z2,T2 = Q
    return (X1*Z2 - X2*Z1) % p == 0 and (Y1*Z2 - Y2*Z1) % p == 0

def ed25519_verify(pub, msg, sig):
    if len(pub)!=32 or len(sig)!=64: return False
    S = int.from_bytes(sig[32:], 'little')
    if S >= L: return False
    try:
        A = point_decompress(pub)
        R = point_decompress(sig[:32])
    except Exception:

    k = int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha512(sig[:32] + pub + msg).digest(), 'little') % L
    SB = point_mul(S, B)
    RA = point_add(R, point_mul(k, A))
    # compare [8]*SB and [8]*RA
    return point_eq(point_mul(8, SB), point_mul(8, RA))
